requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field and 12+ years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 10+ years, or PhD with 7+ years of related experience.
10+ years of professional software development experience using C or C++ in Linux environments.
Experience developing networking or data plane software with strong knowledge of Layer 2, Layer 3, and common networking protocols.
Experience developing or optimizing high-performance packet processing applications using DPDK, networking stacks, or similar technologies.
Experience designing, implementing, debugging, reviewing, and delivering production-quality systems software.
Experience developing software for Data Processing Units (DPUs), SmartNICs, network processors, or networking appliances.
Experience with P4 or other programmable data plane technologies.
Experience contributing to networking architecture, systems software design, or large-scale distributed networking solutions.
Experience working across cross-functional or geographically distributed engineering teams.
